notes.title: Steam Release Has Been Postponed to This September
notes.content:
Hello, this is CFK.

My Divorce Story has been officially released today (Thursday, August 18) on Nintendo Switch.
We regret to inform you that the Steam version, originally scheduled to arrive on the same date, has been pushed back to September release in order to bring the best possible experience on PC.

[b]【Before】 Thursday, August 18, 2022
【After】 September 2022[/b]

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this decision and appreciate your patience in this matter.
